Hi Mike / Anna —

Thanks again for walking through the usage numbers this morning. Per our contract you have an annual committed volume and we run a true-up after the period closes. A couple of items came up internally we want to confirm so you have a clean window for planning and finance on your side:

1) Make-up window for under-delivery:
- We usually allow customers to apply up to 25% of unused committed volume as a "make-up" that can be consumed in the following quarter (not beyond the next immediate quarter). This was set to avoid long-tail rollover.
- For NovaMetrics specifically, given the seasonal spikes you described, we're prepared to offer a one-time exception to allow make-up consumption across two quarters (Q2 and Q3) so you can smooth the spikes — contingent on final sign-off in an amendment.

2) Credit issuance and invoice application timing:
- Credits for make-goods are issued as contra-invoice credits and will appear on the next monthly invoice after the true-up completes. For an annual true-up that finishes in late March, the credit posts on April's invoice cycle (net effect on May payment).
- If NovaMetrics prefers expedited application (so your AP team can net sooner), we can issue a standalone credit memo (PDF) the week after signing the amendment; that requires Finance ops approval and a simple CSV of your account and MRR mapping.

3) Over-usage and carry-forward rules:
- Any overage beyond committed volume in the true-up period is billed at the agreed overage rate and does not offset future commitments.
- If you opt into a multi-quarter make-up amendment (the one-time exception above), we will cap cumulative make-up usage to 25% of annual commit.

4) Accounting / revenue recognition notes (cc Marissa):
- We want to make sure we don't create a material deferral event on your side; Marissa will confirm the form of the credit memo so it maps cleanly to AR.

Attachments: Q1-usage.csv (exported sample), draft amendment template attached as proposed-amendment-v1.docx.

Next steps: 
- If you agree in principle, Ben will send the amendment for signature and Aditya will confirm the clause language. We can issue a provisional credit memo pending the signed amendment if you need cash-flow relief earlier.
